content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-works-how|How Payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, digital creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-what-actually-how-12|selling]] their products online. COREMERCH offers a robust solution with its infrastructure stacks, allowing you to deploy a fully operational digital store without reliance on platforms that restrict access. This guide details how to build your digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-11|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages, ensuring automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, all without the limitations of traditional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current landscape of digital commerce often excludes creators from regions experiencing financial isolation. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal impose geographic restrictions, leaving many without a viable payment solution. COREMERCH’s infrastructure enables creators to establish their digital stores using decentralized tools, ensuring they maintain full ownership and control. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, you bypass these restrictions, creating a resilient framework that stands independent of traditional payment processing platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start the deployment process, gather the necessary tools and resources. You'll need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a GitHub account for version control, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic and ensure you have your digital products ready for upload. Understand the foundational structure of your store and consider using the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for comprehensive blueprints and templates. This preparation ensures a smooth deployment experience.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processing with NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a low transaction fee. Set up your Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and product delivery seamlessly. Use Cloudflare Pages to host your digital store, ensuring that your products are easily accessible once payment is confirmed. This pipeline is essential for automating your sales process, allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing transactions.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own everything after deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages and conduct a test transaction to ensure everything functions as intended. This step is crucial for validating your payment and delivery systems. Monitor the transaction closely and verify that the product is delivered instantly upon successful payment confirmation. With this process tested, you can confidently promote your store to potential buyers, knowing your infrastructure is solid.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, consider ways to scale your operations. You can add more products and enhance your store’s capabilities by integrating additional features using Google Apps Script. Track customer engagement and sales data to identify growth opportunities. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers additional templates and blueprints to expand your store’s functionality. The infrastructure you’ve built allows for seamless scaling without the constraints of traditional platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks, particularly Stack 02 using Cloudflare Pages. This stack can be deployed in 48 hours and includes essential tools like NOWPayments for processing transactions. It empowers you to create a fully operational store without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
No subscriptions or hidden fees — pay only for what you need.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those interested in enhancing their digital commerce capabilities, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your setup. This resource is invaluable for creators looking to leverage Cloudflare Pages effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build your store, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to create a fully functional online store without any fees from traditional payment processors, ensuring you retain ownership and control.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for quick deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02, however, leverages Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, ensuring a more robust infrastructure that is deployed in 48 hours, fully tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting a digital product store. They provide the necessary infrastructure for deploying your store while allowing seamless integration with crypto payment systems through NOWPayments.
How does NOWPayments facilitate transactions?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low transaction fee of 0.5%. It requires no KYC and automates payment confirmation, ensuring immediate fulfillment of product delivery upon successful transaction.
What kind of support can I expect after deployment?

With COREMERCH, you receive 30 days of support after deployment. This ensures you have assistance during the critical initial phase as you familiarize yourself with your new infrastructure and begin processing sales.
Your store is built to scale, empowering you to grow effortlessly.
